title: Relic Synergy Hints — Combo detection UI
description: Detect when active relics have known synergies and display a  SYNERGY!' flash message during the run. Known synergies: hot_rod + coin_press (speed+bits both boosted = 'JACKPOT BUILD'), death_wish + lucky_wing (risky bits game = 'GLASS CANNON'), shield_cloak + ghost_mantle (max survivability = 'TANK BUILD'), turbo_heart + iron_feather (gravity tradeoff balanced = 'CALIBRATED'). Show on first pipe after relic pick with 3s duration. Add synergy name to run stats on game over.
